title: Page lookup response
description: The 200 body of GET /wp-json/resource-hub/v1/page?path={path}: which published WordPress page, if any, the front end should serve at a public path. path is / for the site's root, else the requested segments (/about/team/, slashes optional). The plugin answers from the current state: the static front page for / (Settings > Reading, show_on_front=page and page_on_front), the page whose parent chain matches the path, a page that once had the last segment as its slug, or the one published page that has the last segment as its slug now (a page whose parent moved); the posts page (page_for_posts) and unpublished pages are never answered. A miss is a 200 with page null, not a 404, so the front end's Data Cache, which stores only 200s, keeps it under the pages tag until a page event clears it; the site's root and every path a crawler tries would otherwise reach the CMS on every request. A malformed path is a WordPress REST 400 (wp-error.schema.json).

page.description: The page to serve, or null when no published page answers the path.

A published page and its one canonical public path. When path differs from what was asked for, the front end redirects to it with a computed single-hop 308 and Cache-Control: no-store; when it is the same, the front end reads the page with GET /wp-json/wp/v2/pages/{id}.

id.description: The page's post ID, to read it from the core pages endpoint.

path.description: The page's canonical public path now: / when it is the static front page, else its parent chain and slug (/about/team/). Always with a trailing slash.
